_source: H&H project site edenhousethepark.ae and h-h.ae/development/eden-house-the-park, read 17 September 2026.
_override_note: H&H names its interiors in single unambiguous words - Lounge, kitchen, bedroom, terrace - and all four were opened and confirmed before being captioned. The hero is EHTP - Hero Image, the buildings seen across the water. NOT the file named 'Exterior 15': that is a photograph looking down at the canal promenade with a cyclist on it, and is the clearest example yet of why a filename is not evidence.
image_note: Images are published by H&H, the developer of Eden House The Park, on its own project site, and are reproduced here for a buyer considering the building. They are computer renders showing the developer's intended specification — they are not photographs of any particular apartment, and the finish of an individual unit may differ. Ask to view before relying on them.
caveats: H&H publishes no apartment layouts openly for this building, so none are shown.
